inputs: source commits and collision operator version
t[s], a normalization, H[s^-1], Tgamma[MeV], e± EOS and chemical potentials
physical p[MeV] or comoving q=a*p, explicit quadrature/bin edges/tails
initial neutrino and antineutrino states, flavor basis and sterile dimension
X state, initial abundances, decay/inverse/scattering processes and conservation laws

representations.density_matrix: rho_p, barrho_p, basis and complex offdiagonals; trace per momentum gives occupation sum
representations.separate_spectra: f_nu_alpha and f_antinu_alpha with declared helicity degeneracy; no offdiagonal reconstruction
representations.moments: T_alpha, mu_alpha and closure assumption; reconstructed FD is approximation, not momentum-resolved evidence

nudsmc_conversion.limitation: Public BBN format assumes f_nu=f_antinu; asymmetric histories unsupported without extension
nudsmc_conversion.formula_UR_equal_distributions: f_nu_alpha=f_antinu_alpha=pi^2/p^2 * dn_pair/dp, in hbar=c=1 units with one helicity per particle
requirements: check p versus energy and bin-integrated versus density values
retain raw spectrum, bin edges and MC uncertainty
do not manufacture antineutrino asymmetry or coherence

equation: (d_t-H*p*d_p) rho_p = -i[H_p,rho_p] + C_SM + C_X; separate antineutrino equation
hamiltonian: U M^2 Udag/(2p) + V_SM + V_NSI + V_X; model-dependent basis and medium
outputs: f_nue, f_antinue and other flavors when supported
rho_nu, P_nu from declared momentum integrals
Q_Xnu and Q_emnu as separately labelled energy moments of collision terms
weak n->p and p->n tables only through a declared weak-rate calculation with electrons, tau_n and corrections
energy_bookkeeping: d rho_i/dt+3H(rho_i+P_i)=Q_i; sum_i Q_i=0 for the declared closed set. Export residuals in consistent units, including hbar conversion between MeV and seconds.
checks: Hermiticity and occupancy eigenvalues in [0,1] when full density matrices are represented
moment consistency with spectra and quadrature convergence
common weak corrections and neutron lifetime
initialization epoch: nuDSMC Mathematica BBN starts neutron equilibrium at Tgamma=3 MeV; validate nonstandard earlier histories
unsupported_inferences: isotropic spectra do not supply tensor anisotropic stress
effective open-system kinetics does not prove a fundamental global time arrow
same H(T) does not imply same weak history

extensions_required: capability declaration and rejection of unsupported inputs
bbn_negotiation.primat: custom_background has documented neutrino-correction limitations; external rate/spectrum hook must be verified and implemented
bbn_negotiation.linx: xi_nu affects weak rates without automatically updating rho_nu/Neff; simplified flavor state and interpolation assumptions require adapter work
bbn_negotiation.history: Do not sort away nonmonotonic T evolution; use a valid time parameterization and test caches/interpolation.
